data.name: Carbon Plus
data.description: Carbon Plus is a Malaysia-based biochar project developer operating Malaysia's first industrial-scale commercial biochar plant through its subsidiary Carbon Zero. The Bukit Selar Carbon Station (commissioned 2024) has a nameplate capacity of 500 tonnes of biochar and ~1,200 tCO2e removed annually, uses CrystalTrade's dMRV system, and has received an Ae ex ante rating from BeZero Carbon.
